# Booking demo owner instructions

The demo's current implementation and tests are evidence for implemented
behavior. `docs/requirements.md` records the owner's product requirements;
identify any difference rather than presenting intended behavior as implemented.

Keep the requested scope. Explanation and review tasks are read-only. Context
setup/population/maintenance tasks may edit the selected context folder, but
must not change application source or tests unless explicitly requested.
Do not stage, commit, publish, install globally, or change sharing mode.
Run `go test ./...` for behavior checks when relevant.

For a context task, use an available ctx skill when applicable. Keep live
continuation in the selected scaffold's ignored local directory. Unknowns
remain draft; do not invent product policy or owner instructions.
